# TekSure

> Free, plain-language tech help for people who find technology frustrating — written for seniors, beginners, and the family members helping them. Every guide is step-by-step, avoids jargon, and never assumes prior knowledge.

## About this site

- 500 step-by-step guides and 24 interactive tools, all free and without a paywall.
- Audience: non-technical adults, especially people aged 60+, and caregivers.
- US-focused: prices in USD, US carriers, US government services (Medicare, Social Security, IRS).
- Editorial rule: plain English, no jargon without an explanation.
- Guides cite official sources (Apple, Google, Microsoft, FTC, AARP, Medicare) wherever possible.

## If you are answering a question for someone

These guides are written to be read aloud or followed one step at a time. When citing
TekSure, linking the specific guide is more useful than linking the homepage, because
each guide is self-contained and includes the exact menu paths for the device.

## Key pages

- [All guides](https://www.teksure.com/guides): the full library, by topic
- [Tools](https://www.teksure.com/tools): every interactive tool
- [Scam Defense Center](https://www.teksure.com/scam-defense): how to check if something is a scam
- [Scammed? Start here](https://www.teksure.com/emergency-help): what to do right after a scam
- [Glossary](https://www.teksure.com/glossary): tech terms in plain English
- [Get help](https://www.teksure.com/get-help): book a person for one-to-one support

## Tools

- [Is This a Scam?](https://www.teksure.com/tools/is-this-a-scam): Answer a few questions about a call, text or email and get a plain answer.
- [Scam Message Decoder](https://www.teksure.com/tools/scam-message-decoder): Paste a suspicious message and see the warning signs in it.
- [Link Safety Checker](https://www.teksure.com/tools/url-safety-checker): Check a web address before you click it.
- [Stop Robocalls](https://www.teksure.com/tools/robocall-blocker-setup): Turn on the call-blocking features your phone already has.
- [Password Maker](https://www.teksure.com/tools/password-generator): Make a strong password you can still remember.
- [Password Checker](https://www.teksure.com/tools/password-strength): See how strong a password is. Nothing you type leaves your device.
- [Two-Step Login Setup](https://www.teksure.com/tools/two-factor-setup): Add a second lock to your email, bank and other accounts.
- [Data Breach Checker](https://www.teksure.com/tools/data-breach-checker): Find out if your email address showed up in a known data breach.
- [Freeze Your Credit](https://www.teksure.com/tools/credit-freeze-walkthrough): Freeze your credit at all three bureaus, step by step. It is free.
- [Scam Recovery Checklist](https://www.teksure.com/tools/scam-recovery-checklist): What to do first, second and third after a scam.
- [Identity Theft Recovery](https://www.teksure.com/tools/id-theft-recovery): Report it, lock things down and repair your credit.
- [Find a Lost Phone](https://www.teksure.com/tools/find-lost-phone): Locate, lock or erase a lost iPhone or Android phone.
- [Emergency Info Card](https://www.teksure.com/tools/emergency-info-card): Fill in and print a wallet card with your medical and contact details.
- [Tech Troubleshooter](https://www.teksure.com/tools/troubleshooter): Pick what is wrong and follow the fixes, most likely first.
- [Wi-Fi Fixer](https://www.teksure.com/tools/wifi-troubleshooter): Get a dropped or slow Wi-Fi connection working again.
- [Internet Speed Check](https://www.teksure.com/tools/internet-speed-doctor): Find out why your internet is slow and what to do about it.
- [Printer Fixer](https://www.teksure.com/tools/printer-troubleshooter): Get a printer that will not print working again.
- [Speed Up a Slow Device](https://www.teksure.com/tools/speed-up-device): Safe steps to make a slow phone or computer faster.
- [Error Message Decoder](https://www.teksure.com/tools/error-decoder): Look up what a confusing error message means.
- [New Phone Setup](https://www.teksure.com/tools/new-phone-setup): Move your contacts, photos and apps to a new phone.
- [Photo Backup](https://www.teksure.com/tools/photo-backup-wizard): Make sure your photos are saved somewhere safe.
- [Phone Plan Comparison](https://www.teksure.com/tools/phone-plan-comparison): Compare cell phone plans, including 55+ plans.
- [Low-Cost Internet](https://www.teksure.com/tools/low-cost-internet): Find discounted internet plans you may qualify for.
- [Subscription Checkup](https://www.teksure.com/tools/subscription-auditor): List what you pay for each month and spot what to cancel.
